short_title: Prevent plaintext secrets in source repos
story: As an engineer I want to ensure that no plaintext passwords, API keys, certificates, or tokens are committed to source-controlled repositories so that compromise of a developer workstation or repo mirror does not leak production credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-commit and server-side push-protection block known secret patterns; CI fails on new secret-shaped strings; detected leaks auto-create incidents with rotation SLA.

short_title: Detect and remediate secrets in history
story: As a DevSecOps engineer I want a one-time and continuous historical sweep of repos and CI variables so that legacy plaintext secrets are surfaced, rotated, and purged with chain-of-custody evidence.
acceptance_criteria: All branches scanned with full history at least quarterly; findings record NHI bucket and rotation status; P0 findings closed within 30 days.

short_title: JIT short-lived cloud credentials via OIDC
story: As a platform engineer I want CI/CD jobs to federate to AWS/Azure/GCP via OIDC so that no long-lived cloud access keys exist in pipeline variables.
acceptance_criteria: 100% new pipelines use OIDC trust policies scoped by sub/aud; legacy static keys retired with burn-down inventory; mis-scoped trust policies detected.

story: As a platform engineer I want every workload to receive a short-lived attested identity so that service-to-service auth does not rely on long-lived shared secrets.
acceptance_criteria: SPIFFE Workload API reachable from production workloads; SVID TTL <=1h with auto-rotation; trust-domain boundaries reviewed.

short_title: Dynamic database credentials via broker leases
story: As an SRE I want application DB credentials issued on-demand by a broker with TTLs so that compromise of an app instance does not yield a long-lived DB credential.
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic-creds available for in-scope DB engines; max TTL set per data class; static-password exceptions registered with expiry.

short_title: Automated rotation of long-lived static secrets
story: As an SRE I want long-lived shared secrets rotated on schedule and on incident with zero manual transcription so that stale credentials do not accumulate.
acceptance_criteria: Rotation pipelines documented per NHI bucket; >95% rotated within policy interval; failures alert on-call in <15 minutes.

story: As an incident responder I want one-click revocation of any NHI's active credentials and sessions so that a confirmed compromise is contained inside regulator-expected windows.
acceptance_criteria: Revocation API callable from SOAR within 1 minute; token-introspection invalidation in <5 minutes; forensic export available to IR.

short_title: K8s secret consumption without on-disk plaintext
story: As a platform engineer I want pods to consume secrets via CSI / agent-injector / projected SA tokens so that secrets are never written as plaintext K8s Secret objects.
acceptance_criteria: Cluster policy denies plaintext production-credential Secrets; CSI/injector deployed cluster-wide; etcd at-rest encryption with CMK enforced.

story: As a DevSecOps engineer I want image-pull credentials scoped per namespace/workload with short TTLs so that a compromised node cannot pull arbitrary production images.
acceptance_criteria: Per-workload pull creds supported (ECR/ACR/GAR/Harbor); no shared imagePullSecret in prod; pull-credential rotation automated.

story: As an SRE I want Terraform/Ansible/Pulumi runs to fetch secrets at apply-time from a broker so that secrets never persist in state files, var-files, or runner caches.
acceptance_criteria: State-file scanners enforce zero-plaintext-secret; dynamic-provider integration deployed; runner caches encrypted/short-lived.

story: As a platform engineer I want monitoring agents to use scoped rotatable ingest tokens so that a compromised host cannot exfiltrate beyond its own telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens scoped per env and agent class; rotated >=quarterly without gaps; agent configs forbid embedded application secrets.

story: As an engineer I want Kafka/RabbitMQ/Pub-Sub/Service-Bus clients to authenticate with mTLS or IAM-signed requests so that lateral movement via the event bus is prevented.
acceptance_criteria: mTLS/cloud-IAM default for in-scope brokers; SAS rotation automated; cross-tenant topic ACLs enforced.

story: As an SRE I want AD service accounts migrated to gMSA/sMSA (or eliminated via federation) so that svc_-prefixed identities are not held together by static passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory of svc_ accounts with eligibility classification; gMSA migration path approved; rotation policy enforced where gMSA infeasible.

story: As a platform engineer I want every API gateway to present a strong upstream identity (mTLS, signed JWT, SigV4) so that upstream services can mutually authenticate the gateway.
acceptance_criteria: HMAC-only upstream patterns deprecated in prod; gateway cert lifecycle automated; anomalous upstream auth failures alerted.

story: As an SRE I want RPA bots to retrieve credentials per-session from a vault with no embedded passwords so that bot identities cannot persist after offboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Vault integration enabled for orchestrators; bots use functional identities distinct from humans where feasible; sessions tied to ticket/process.

story: As a DevSecOps engineer I want builds to sign artifacts with keyless / short-lived identities (Sigstore, HSM-backed Authenticode) so that signing keys cannot be stolen at rest.
acceptance_criteria: Keyless signing available for >=90% artefact types; HSM-backed long-lived signing where keyless infeasible with quorum operator policy; verification enforced at admission.

story: As an architect I want regulated workloads to release high-value secrets only after TEE attestation so that secrets are bound to a measured execution environment.
acceptance_criteria: Attestation-gated release documented; broker supports at least one TEE flow; pilot exists for regulated workload class; policy handles revocation and stale quotes.

story: As a platform engineer I want LLM agents to obtain tool credentials via a broker with per-tool per-session scoped tokens so that prompt-injection cannot exfiltrate long-lived secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Static API keys for agent tools forbidden in new patterns; OBO or workload-broker tokens used with audited scopes; tool calls logged with agent identity and prompt provenance.

story: As a platform engineer I want IoT/OT/ATM/branch devices to enrol via DPS/EST/SCEP with hardware-rooted identity so that fleet-wide PSKs are eliminated.
acceptance_criteria: Per-device certs with TPM/SE binding where supported; PSK/default-credential fleets have retirement plan; device cert lifecycle automated.

story: As an SRE I want RACF/ACF2/Top-Secret/IBM-i started-task and batch credentials rotated under change-window governance so that core-banking NHIs are not effectively static.
acceptance_criteria: Vault integration to mainframe; runbooks per started-task class with rollback; ICSF master-key custody includes quorum operators.

story: As an SRE I want backup/DR agents to operate with least-privilege vaulted credentials so that ransomware operators cannot turn a backup agent into tier-0 takeover.
acceptance_criteria: Backup-service AD accounts vaulted; immutable-storage tokens in HSM-backed vault; backup-tier admin actions require MFA + JIT elevation.

story: As an engineer I want every inbound webhook verified by HMAC/mTLS/replay-protected JWT so that spoofed callbacks cannot drive business logic.
acceptance_criteria: Default middleware enforces signature verification; signing secrets rotatable without endpoint downtime; replay-window enforced.

story: As a NetOps engineer I want router/switch/firewall/SD-WAN credentials rotated via vault-integrated TACACS+/RADIUS so that shared device-admin passwords and SNMP communities are eliminated.
acceptance_criteria: TACACS+/RADIUS vault integration deployed across fabric; SNMPv3 + per-device creds enforced; vendor cloud-controller tokens vaulted/rotated.

story: As an architect I want CDR/Open-Banking/payments-rail partner clients authenticated by FAPI-2.0-compliant mTLS with sender-constrained tokens so that B2B integrations meet regulator expectations.
acceptance_criteria: Partner mTLS client certs lifecycle-managed; private_key_jwt or DPoP used for tokens; per-partner key compromise drill annually.

story: As a DevSecOps engineer I want all third-party OAuth apps inventoried, risk-scored, and revocable so that shadow integrations cannot persist after vendor offboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant-wide OAuth-app inventory refreshed weekly; high-scope apps require approval; stale refresh tokens auto-revoked.

story: As a platform engineer I want the secrets manager's own identities governed with the same rigour as customer workloads so that the vault itself is not a SPOF.
acceptance_criteria: Root token sealed offline (Shamir/KMS unseal); replication tokens rotated/scoped; auto-unseal KMS keys under same controls as customer keys.

story: As an SRE I want a recurring sweep that identifies and retires NHIs unused for >N days so that forgotten identities do not become breach vectors.
acceptance_criteria: Activity-based dormancy threshold per NHI bucket; owner-attestation required for retention extension; retired identities exported to immutable evidence.

story: As a product owner I need to know how many plaintext secrets remain in our repos broken down by team, NHI bucket, repo, and age with a trend line so that I can prioritise remediation investment.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows total findings, P0 findings, MTTR, and 30/60/90-day trend; drill-down per team and repo with NHI tagging; freshness <=24h.

story: As an internal auditor I need a complete owner-attested inventory of every NHI so that orphans, sprawl, and unowned credentials can be evidenced and remediated.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage >=95% of in-scope NHI buckets; annual owner re-attestation; inventory exports to GRC.

story: As a product owner I need monthly KPIs on rotation coverage, rotation freshness, and rotation-failure backlog by NHI bucket so that I can demonstrate control effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: KPIs split by NHI bucket and data classification; failure burn-down at executive forum; targets agreed annually with CISO/audit.

story: As an internal auditor I need a one-click APRA CPS 234 evidence pack for any in-scope NHI bucket so that regulator interactions are repeatable and timely.
acceptance_criteria: Pack assembles from control library and raw artefacts; signed and timestamped; generation completes in <1 business day.

story: As an architect I need a quarterly scorecard mapping the secrets programme to Essential 8 maturity levels and SP 800-207 ZT pillars so that the primary FI lens is auditable.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard published quarterly to Risk Committee; annual independent maturity review; gaps tracked with owner and due date.

story: As a vendor-risk manager I need every SaaS or OAuth-app integration risk-scored on data scope, residency, secret-handling, and incident-disclosure SLAs so that supply-chain risk is governed to in-house standard.
acceptance_criteria: Risk-scoring rubric published; Tier-1 vendor attestations annual; high-risk integrations reviewed at CAB.

story: As a vendor-risk manager I need explicit data-flow evidence for every vault/KMS/HSM/SaaS secrets product so that APRA-regulated data does not transit non-approved jurisdictions.
acceptance_criteria: Data-flow diagrams maintained per vendor; in-AU residency selected where required; cross-border processing logged for CPS 230 BCM.

short_title: Engineer training and secure-coding adoption KPI
story: As a product owner I need every engineer who ships code to complete secrets-management secure-coding training in the last 12 months so that culture-level controls are evidenced.
acceptance_criteria: Completion >=98% of active engineers; content refreshed annually against OWASP and DBIR findings; champions network active per BU.

story: As an internal auditor I need every deviation from the secrets standard registered with owner, expiry, and compensating-control evidence so that risk acceptance is intentional and time-bound.
acceptance_criteria: Exceptions captured in GRC with default expiry <=12 months; expired exceptions auto-escalate; quarterly trend reporting.

story: As an internal auditor I need every break-glass identity and HSM/CA/KMS quorum-operator role inventoried, monitored, and drilled so that high-privilege standing access is detectable and testable.
acceptance_criteria: Quarterly inventory review; SOC same-day review of any break-glass use; quorum drills semi-annually.

story: As an incident responder I need every secrets/identity-related incident captured with NHI attribution, MITRE T1552 sub-technique, and lessons-learned so that programme investment is data-driven.
acceptance_criteria: Incident schema includes NHI bucket and ATT&CK technique; RCA template includes contributing control-gap; findings flow into roadmap.

story: As an architect I need quarterly reports on signed-artifact coverage (SLSA level, signed-image %, in-toto attestations) so that supply-chain controls evidence improving posture.
acceptance_criteria: SLSA-level tracked per artefact class; unsigned-artefact admission requires exception; provenance verifiers in production CD.

story: As an architect I need a crypto-inventory and PQC-migration readiness scorecard so that 2030-deadline obligations are visible to the board.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory covers vaults/CAs/HSMs/mTLS/code-signing; PQC roadmap with milestones; hybrid-cert pilot before 2027.

story: As a product owner I need the 19-vendor evaluation matrix refreshed each release cycle with capability deltas highlighted so that vendor choice remains defensible.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix re-populated against canonical UC catalog per release; capability deltas flagged per vendor; independent reviewer signs off.

story: As a product owner I need a cadence of stakeholder communications on the secrets programme so that delivery, risk, and value are understood across audiences.
acceptance_criteria: Communications calendar approved (monthly engineering, quarterly board minimum); each release accompanied by impact briefing; feedback captured into backlog.

story: As an internal auditor I need monthly fleet-posture reports on IoT/OT/ATM/branch-peripheral identities so that default-credential and PSK exposure is visible and burning down.
acceptance_criteria: Inventory by device class with credential type; default-credential and PSK fleets tracked with retirement plan; deltas reported at Operational Risk Committee.

story: As an internal auditor I need evidence that logs and telemetry pipelines do not propagate secrets onward to Datadog/Splunk/Elastic so that observability is not itself a leak channel.
acceptance_criteria: Log-scrubbing rules enforced at agent and ingest; periodic sampled audit of indexed telemetry; findings flow into UC-N-001 dashboard.

story: As an auditor I need attestation evidence for any workload claiming TEE-bound secret release so that the strongest-trust pattern is verifiable rather than declarative.
acceptance_criteria: Attestation logs retained per data-class policy; verifier policy review periodic; failed-attestation incidents reported.

story: As a product owner I need KPIs specific to AI-agent NHIs (tools per session, scope inflation, refusal/escalation rates, prompt-injection-induced credential calls) so that governance scales with agent adoption.
acceptance_criteria: AI-agent NHI inventory maintained alongside UC-N-002; per-tool credential issuance reported weekly; anomalous patterns alert SOC.

story: As an internal auditor I need mainframe/midrange/RPA posture reported alongside cloud so that the legacy long-tail is visible and exception-register pressure is data-driven.
acceptance_criteria: Mainframe + RPA rotation/coverage shown on the same dashboard as cloud (UC-N-001/003); aging exceptions on legacy NHIs auto-escalate; modernisation roadmap published.

story: As a platform engineer I want autonomous AI agents to receive tool and API credentials only from a broker that mints per-session, per-tool, scoped, short-lived credentials, so that a compromised or prompt-injected agent cannot obtain or exfiltrate a long-lived secret.
acceptance_criteria: Static long-lived API keys for agents are forbidden in new patterns; agent credentials are broker-minted, scoped per tool and per session, and short-lived; every issuance is logged with the agent identity, owner and requesting purpose; issuance is denied to unregistered or unowned agents.

story: As a secrets owner I want credentials held by autonomous agents to rotate automatically on a risk cadence and to be revoked immediately when an agent is decommissioned or shows signs of compromise, so that no agent credential outlives the agent's purpose or a containment event.
acceptance_criteria: Agent-held credentials rotate automatically on a risk-tiered cadence with no service interruption; decommissioning or compromise of an agent triggers immediate revocation of its issued credentials and active sessions; rotation/revocation coverage for agent identities is a tracked KPI and trends up; no long-lived static agent secret persists past its rotation window.

story: As a risk owner I want every credential issued to an autonomous agent to be scoped to the minimum tools and data its declared task needs, and for over-broad agent secret-scope to be detected and flagged, so that excessive agency in the credential plane cannot translate a single agent compromise into broad lateral access.
acceptance_criteria: Agent credentials are scoped per task and per tool by default; over-broad or unused scopes on agent credentials are detected and flagged for right-sizing; scope grants are tied to the agent's declared purpose and owner; excessive-agency conditions (credential scope beyond declared purpose) are surfaced to the owner.
